ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Sponsor sales, Signed and later stages need Amount, Contract signed date and Sponsor tier.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sponsor_sales", CASE(StageName, "Prospect", 1, "Meeting held", 2, "Proposal sent", 3, "Negotiating", 4, "Contract out", 5, "Signed", 6, 0) >= 6, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(Contract_signed_date__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Sponsor_tier__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Contract signed date and Sponsor tier before moving to Signed.
